# Tag

```tsx
import { Tag, tagVariants } from "@s0l/design-system"
```

A short label for status, categories or filters. Mirrors the Figma Tag: Size (Small / Medium) × Color (Neutral / Accent / Info / Success / Warning / Danger) × Emphasis (Soft / Strong) × State (Default / Disabled) × Icon Only, with Show Icon and Dismissible.

## Example

From the Storybook story; names like `args` or `label` are the story controls.

```tsx
<StoryTag {...args} />
```

## Figma notes

Mirrors the Figma Tag component: Size (Small / Medium) × Color (Neutral / Accent / Info / Success / Warning / Danger) × Emphasis (Soft / Strong) × State (Default / Disabled) × Icon Only, with Show Icon and Dismissible. The label is Label/Small; the icons are 16px and take --tag-icon, the Icon token of each color.

## Variants

`tagVariants` (cva):

| Prop | Options | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `size` | `sm`, `md` | `sm` |
| `color` | `neutral`, `accent`, `info`, `success`, `warning`, `danger` | `neutral` |
| `emphasis` | `soft`, `strong` | `soft` |
| `iconOnly` | `true`, `false` | `false` |
| `disabled` | `true`, `false` | `false` |

## Props

Documented props only; every component also accepts the props of the element or Base UI part it renders (`className`, events, ARIA…).

`TagProps`:

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `icon?` | `React.ReactNode` | Figma Show Icon: the 16px leading icon (the only content with Icon Only). |
| `iconOnly?` | `boolean` | Figma Icon Only: shows just the icon in a circle. Give it an `aria-label`. |
| `onDismiss?` | `(event: React.MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => void` | Figma Dismissible: shows the X, which calls this when pressed. |
| `dismissLabel?` | `string` | Accessible name of the X. |

## Types

`TagProps`

## Rules

- Import `Tag` from `@s0l/design-system`. Do not rebuild it with plain HTML and Tailwind classes.
- Style it through its props and variants first. Use `className` only for layout (margin, width, grid placement), never to change its colors, typography or radius.
- Colors come from the S0L tokens; see [color](../foundations/color.md).
